findings.subject: GetGenderData nonempty response layout
findings.native_fact: field 3 is the number of following scalar tokens; client divides it by 2 and consumes genderID,Boolean pairs
findings.implementation: _genders emits the exact flat scalar pair layout
findings.fix: emit true#guid#ps4_id#(2*N)#genderID#True...; keep empty form count 0

findings.subject: ShopInfo display field order
findings.implementation: returns authenticated profile username, NP, crystals
findings.fix: return profile username, local NP, local crystals; remove level from the wire reply

findings.subject: SyncCrystals display field order
findings.native_fact: the same three offsets populate name,np,crystals
findings.implementation: returns authenticated profile username, NP, crystals and accepts native Int64 consumedCount
findings.fix: return profile username, local NP, local crystals; client receipt fields remain non-authoritative

findings.subject: ItemData.imagePath
findings.native_fact: EntryItem passes imagePath to a loader that classifies known path segments, removes a four-character extension, and may take the final 41 characters
findings.implementation: non-bundle thumbnails derive from validated shipped manifests; bundles require a compatible explicit path
findings.fix: derive and validate a compatible shipped thumbnail path; never invent or accept an unverified arbitrary path

findings.subject: TypeShop enum
findings.implementation: shop type is restricted to 0 through 3

findings.subject: Bundle list framing
findings.native_fact: field 3 is ItemData entry count and each entry occupies one serialized EntryData token
findings.implementation: _bundle uses _list with ItemData and configured child order

findings.subject: purchase statuses
findings.native_fact: buy explicitly handles enum values 0/1/2 (OK/NOCRYSTALS/NOXP); gift handles 0/1/3 and requires six fields; buy does not present a dedicated ISPURCHASED branch
findings.implementation: uses exact enum strings; idempotent buy returns ISPURCHASED and gift includes target plus a sixth compatibility field
findings.fix: retain exact strings; test the ignored buy ISPURCHASED path separately from success UI

findings.subject: gift target identifier
findings.native_fact: FriendEntry.OnClick copies displayed friend name into giftNameFriendTarget; OnClickGift sends only that string
findings.implementation: resolves an exact displayed username across local platforms and requires one unambiguous friend relation
findings.fix: retain ambiguity rejection because the wire carries no platform discriminator

findings.subject: gender IDs and symbolic fields
findings.native_fact: EntryItem compares ItemData.gender with TypeGender.ToString; selected IDs 0/1 parse TypeData while 2/3/5/6 parse ItemData directly
findings.implementation: wardrobe items emit MALE/FEMALE and GetShopTypeData selects the native DTO by selected ID
findings.fix: keep ID 4 empty because its native callback branch does not deserialize rows
